Sniper City updates

Patch notes for Sniper City, newest first.

15 November 2026

New in solo matches

  • A 10-second match briefing with the rules. It can be skipped.
  • Half-time air drop with the AWM: three bullets, one shot kills, shots pass through walls.
  • Scope vision: 30 seconds of thermal and night vision per match.
  • RPG-7 with two rockets.
  • Three dogs tied on rooftops that you can unleash and send after an enemy.
  • A once-per-match prayer to the angel.
  • Lucifer, earned with three gun kills in a row.
  • Drifting fog banks and a red glint from snipers aiming at you.

Combat

  • Rifle bullets in solo matches now take time to arrive and drop over distance. The scope shows marks for 50, 100 and 150 metres.
  • Kill cam: when another sniper kills you, the view cuts to them and looks back down the shot.
  • Aim assist on touch screens gently pulls toward a visible enemy while you aim. It can be turned off on the title screen.

The city

  • Neon signs in red and white hang off the buildings.
  • Windows in the far towers switch on and off, and their light now shows through the fog.
  • Air-conditioner units with turning fans, antennas with red warning lamps, and washing on poles and lines.
  • Headlights and tail lights move along the streets below, and aircraft cross overhead.

Controls

  • New phone layout: fixed joystick, sprint lock, weapon slots and a swipe menu for the decoy and playing dead.
  • New first-person arms and a Desert Eagle sidearm.
  • Every on-screen button can be moved, resized or hidden, including the Lucifer, dog and skip buttons.

Fixes

  • Pausing no longer resets the air drop, dogs, rockets, prayer or scope vision.
  • Rifle ammunition is restored correctly after the AWM.
  • Dogs follow the rooftops, jumps, ladders and cables. They no longer run through walls.
  • Rockets hit reliably at low frame rates.
  • The game's files now load when you press Play, so the page opens faster.
  • Solo-only models are downloaded only when a solo match starts.
